reason: Official EML metadata defines Species as the species of seagrass observed and Percent Cover as percent cover of species observed in quadrat, but v1 did not establish an explicit recorded-zero/absence state distinct from a missing species row before response access.
interpretation: The dataset is structurally promising, but v1 cannot infer next-year recorded loss without stronger official zero-versus-missing semantics. It neither supports nor contradicts the Tampa early-warning hypothesis.
next_rule: Freeze v1. A separately versioned response-blind metadata-only v2 may inspect the full EML measurementScale, numericDomain and missingValueCode before any CSV access.
